rationale: All 15 spec acceptance criteria are met and browser verification passed. One CI-blocking standards violation: both commit messages use lowercase first word ('enable', 'add') violating the enforced EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence format. All three review lenses ran successfully. The unconditional sticky wrapper div raised by multiple lenses is an acknowledged architectural choice in the spec ('wrapper has no class when stickyHeader is false') with no current direct-child CSS selector breakage confirmed by grep. 3 findings deferred (unconditional wrapper, test fragility, WorkflowDrawer overflow context); 2 dismissed (ExpandPopup non-goal per spec, react-tooltip z-index no confirmed breakage).

standards_review.notes: Both commits violate the enforced format. 'enable stickyHeader on code blocks...' and 'add stickyHeader prop to CodeBlock...' use lowercase first word. git-workflow.md requires uppercase first word and states Tekton CI blocks on violations. Required: 'Enable ...' and 'Add ...'.
Branch EPMCDME-14054_add-copy-code-block matches the required pattern.

findings.problem: Both commit messages use a lowercase first word after the colon: 'enable stickyHeader on code blocks in markdown chat messages' and 'add stickyHeader prop to CodeBlock with sticky wrapper div'. The project git-workflow.md enforces 'First word after colon must start with uppercase' via Tekton CI (pipeline blocks on violations).
findings.impact: Tekton CI pipeline will block the MR merge.
findings.recommendation: Amend both commits: 'EPMCDME-14054: Add stickyHeader prop to CodeBlock with sticky wrapper div' and 'EPMCDME-14054: Enable stickyHeader on code blocks in markdown chat messages'.
